## Change

Describe the bounded change and its eval/evidence impact.

## Verification

List exact commands and results. Gate changes need passing and seeded-failure tests.

## Data and claims checklist

- [ ] No credentials, personal data, or production endpoints were added.
- [ ] New datasets have documented provenance and redistribution rights.
- [ ] Reports are generated from machine-readable artifacts.
- [ ] External-system claims identify an exact component revision/image and environment.
